name: Hemory
tagline: Keep listening. Searchable memory for your AI agents.
description: Hemory comes from Hear + Memory. It's not meeting transcription: Hemory listens on the phone or Apple Watch you already own, and keeps every conversation as memory. Your day is auto-split into moments with speaker labels, then settles into a private, searchable memory. Connect it to Claude, Codex, Cursor, or any agent over MCP, and your AI finally has real context to revisit what you heard and build on it.

name: Eclatira
tagline: Conversational Video Agent That Plugs Into Any Stack
description: Plug real-time conversational video AI into any application. Eclatira gives developers native voice-to-voice, live vision, and full-stack execution across custom APIs, MCPs, and 3,000+ apps. Ship autonomous multimodal video agents fast.

name: Chit
tagline: A printed receipt of your day in Claude Code
description: Chit reads the Claude Code transcripts already on your disk and prints the day back as a receipt, grouped by project and ready to paste into a standup. A 777 KB Mac app. No Hammerspoon, no Python, no account, and no network code in the binary at all.

name: MakerMap
tagline: A living map of makers and what they’re building
description: MakerMap is a living map of the maker world. Discover 4,000+ makers and products, search by niche, location, interests or what people are building, explore live profiles, and find people worth meeting. Add yourself and become part of the map.

name: Paragraph Notes
tagline: A private Markdown notes app for Mac
description: Paragraph Notes is a privacy-focused Markdown notes app for Mac. Write in a simple, distraction-free plain text editor. Paragraph Notes collects no data and never connects to the internet. Notes are stored locally in an open, portable format. Use Paragraph Notes free for up to 20 notes. Upgrade to Pro with a one-time in-app purchase for unlimited notes.

name: GoodSocials
tagline: AI social media manager for LinkedIn. Only authentic content
description: AI social media manager for LinkedIn. Writes high quality content, you approve it in a kanban board, it schedules so you post regularly, close to daily.

name: Fewer
tagline: The launcher that counts how often you pick up your phone
description: An Android launcher built around pickups, not screen time. A quiet home screen shows today's task, how many times you've looked at your phone (and how many for nothing) and the six tools you actually use. Time sinks get a pause. No server, no account, no ads.

name: Psst
tagline: A shared shopping list that remembers what things cost
description: Psst is a shared shopping list. The useful part is that it remembers what you paid. Photograph a receipt and the lines come back structured, each one showing a crop of the row it came from and what that item cost last time, and where. Most of the work went into not saying so when it isn't sure. Two prices in different units are never compared, and comparison is on unit price, not the line total: buying 2kg instead of 1kg is not a price rise. iOS and Android.

name: Kleanly
tagline: One tap in the notch locks your keyboard and trackpad
description: Kleanly lives in your MacBook's notch. Tap it once and your keyboard and trackpad are locked, so you can wipe everything down while your video keeps playing. Kids can slap the keys during a cartoon and nothing gets typed. Double tap the trackpad when you're done. New since our first launch: the notch control, in-app updates, moving your license to a new Mac yourself, and a small tab on displays without a notch.

name: Lisen
tagline: Free Read Aloud with Cartesia Voices
description: Free read aloud for any article with your Cartesia voices. No subscription on top of your Cartesia plan.

name: SOUND
tagline: Give every Mac app its own EQ, volume, and speaker.
description: macOS has one volume slider and no equalizer. SOUND gives every playing app its own 8-band EQ, independent volume, and output device—right from the menu bar. No virtual audio driver or account; audio stays on your Mac. Free and available in 10 languages.

name: VehicleERP
tagline: VehicleERP - Used Car Management Software
description: VehicleERP is used car management software built for dealers who buy, sell, and manage vehicles. Track inventory, purchases, expenses, sales, payments, GST bills, partners, staff, branches, and profit on one platform. AI helps price vehicles, scan documents, spot ageing stock and mistakes, forecast performance, and answer questions using your business data.

name: What to Order
tagline: Find food you’ll love on any restaurant menu
description: Ever sat down at The Cheesecake Factory and been handed the menu? 331 items. You flip through it, get nowhere, and order the same thing as last time. What to Order works the other way around. Tell it what you’re in the mood for and it checks every dish on the menu for you. “Spicy” works. “Spicy vegetarian” too. Ask for “Thanksgiving dinner for 2” and you get a whole order, pumpkin cheesecake included. We have 7 US chains so far. Eating somewhere else? Snap a photo of the menu. It’s free.

name: Inqueria: Interviews that Hold Up
tagline: AI that interviews your users like a trained researcher
description: Inqueria runs AI-moderated interviews that adapt to every answer, the way a trained researcher would. It redacts PII in-house before any model sees a transcript, then turns every conversation into themes with the exact quotes behind them. It checks each theme against every transcript and shows you the participants who disagree. Run 50 interviews overnight. Skip the month it takes to schedule five.

name: ZenMode OS · Android Launcher
tagline: Good phone habits! paid in gold, all with your friends.
description: ZenMode OS is an open source Android launcher that makes the intentional choice easier than the impulsive one. One Zen Score, real accountability, and rewards that land in gold instead of dopamine.

name: Bump
tagline: Your AI collections team for email and WhatsApp
description: Bump is an AI collections engine for accounts receivable. It works every overdue invoice to paid — chasing across email and WhatsApp, reading replies, tracking promises and payment plans, and escalating on its own — so getting paid runs itself. Like adding a collections team, without hiring one.

name: Brainlist Calendar
tagline: every notes entry shows up in your list AND your calendar
description: It's made from someone with ADHD for people who want to get tasks and events done. It helps you plan your day, with a list view that shows all events and tasks in one timeline AND a monthly calendar view that syncs automatically, as well as an Eisenhower importance/urgency Matrix and a spin-the-wheel picker for when you can't decide what to start with. With Brain Dump you quickly capture type or dictate a thought and then you can get back to it later without the note being buried away forever.

name: Big Weather
tagline: Menu Bar Forecast, now with AI Insights
description: Big Weather puts the weather in your Mac's menu bar: the days ahead as one curve you can scrub through, UV hour by hour, and with Premium, AI insights and official weather warnings.

name: ButterShare
tagline: Share Anything, to Anyone. No File Limits
description: ButterShare allows you to share files of any size directly between devices without the need for cloud storage or sign-ups. With a simple 3-step process, you can send files instantly using a 6-character room code. The service ensures privacy with end-to-end encryption, making it ideal for sharing large files securely.

name: Farao
tagline: Trade with friends, post thesis, earn money
description: Follow your friends and other traders whose records are visible, read the thesis behind every position, and mirror the trade at your own size.
